subject: Thursday double feature
body: We will show the restoration at 6.30 and the short documentary at 8.15. The ticket desk opens half an hour before the first screening.

subject: Archive room appointment
body: The 1920s map collection is ready for your visit on Tuesday. Please use the side entrance and ask at reception for the reading room folder.

subject: Steam engine wash day
body: We have booked the wash bay for Sunday from 9 until noon. Volunteers can bring soft brushes, and the museum will provide buckets and overalls.

subject: Opening reception guest count
body: The artist expects around 35 people at the reception. We have arranged a small table for the catalogue and two benches near the entrance.

subject: School matinee seating
body: The two classes will sit in the front stalls, with teachers on the aisle seats. Doors open at 10.15 and the performance finishes before lunch.

subject: Studio floor inspection
body: The floor contractor can visit on 4 August. We will mark the loose board with tape and keep the space free until the repair is done.

subject: Caption file for Sunday
body: The caption file is synced with the new cut. Could you check the opening credits once more on the small screen before we schedule the matinee?

subject: Rehearsal room booking
body: The hall is available each Tuesday in May from 7 to 9. I have put the risers and music stands on the booking form as well.

subject: Concert dress rehearsal
body: We will rehearse the full programme on Friday evening. Please arrive with your instrument warmed up, as the stage call begins promptly at 6.45.

subject: School visit timetable
body: The puppet show lasts 40 minutes, followed by a short question time. We can fit the first group at 9.30 and the second just after 11.

subject: Ceremony wording proof
body: I have adjusted the reading order and added the couple's chosen welcome. Please confirm the start time and venue spelling before I print the final cards.

subject: Summer concert invitations
body: The invitation proof looks tidy. We should order 120 copies and leave a stack at the library desk for anyone who wants to join us.

subject: Stallholder arrival map
body: The map shows the unloading lane and each stall number. Traders can arrive from 6.30, and the market opens to shoppers at 8.

subject: Power connection list
body: I have noted which trucks need a standard outlet and which are self-powered. Please check the list against the final site plan before we send it to the electrician.

subject: Room hire for chess group
body: The small meeting room is free on Wednesday evenings. It seats 14 comfortably, and the tea urn can be booked for an extra two pounds.

subject: Cabin inspection notes
body: The bunks and mattresses are in good order. We should replace the curtain in the west cabin before the next group arrives.

subject: October volunteer sessions
body: We will open the repair tables on the first and third Saturday next month. Sewing machines and small appliances are welcome; please leave bicycles for another date.

subject: Street tree watering
body: The young trees on Elm Walk need watering twice this week. I have left a hose attachment in the garden shed for the volunteers.

subject: Parade banner proof
body: The new banner is 12 feet wide and fits the frame. Please check the sponsor order and the parade date before we approve the printer's sample.

subject: Family changing room hours
body: The family changing room will close at 4 on Friday for routine tile work. The main changing area stays open, and staff can direct visitors to the temporary showers.

subject: Treadmill service booking
body: The technician is booked for Tuesday at 9. Please keep the three treadmills by the front windows free so he can test them after the belt change.

subject: Court resurfacing dates
body: Courts one and two close from 12 to 15 August for resurfacing. Courts three and four remain available, weather permitting.

subject: Weekend cart path
body: The third-hole cart path is closed while the surface is repaired. Golfers may walk the short route and should follow the temporary markers beside the pond.

subject: Uniform sizes
body: We have ordered the extra small and large jerseys. Could you confirm the number of medium shirts by Monday so every team receives its kit before opening day?

subject: Pitch cover volunteers
body: The covers need to be on by 8 if the rain arrives. Two people can manage each side; please reply if you can help before practice.

subject: Fixture list correction
body: The under-15 team plays at North Hall on the 21st, not the 20th. All other dates in the fixture sheet are unchanged.

subject: Music stand collection
body: We have borrowed eight stands from the school for the concert. Please return them to the music room on Monday morning and leave the chairs stacked by the wall.

subject: Clay workshop supplies
body: The instructor needs 10 blocks of white clay and two rolling pins. The group has aprons, but we could use another box of paper towels.

subject: Spring orientation date
body: We have reserved the training room for May 6. New volunteers will meet the coordinators, review the activity calendar and choose a regular session.

subject: Sunday dog walking roster
body: The morning walk starts at 8.30 and the afternoon group leaves at 1. Please bring a lead if you have one; spare water bowls are kept by the shed.

subject: Holiday stay availability
body: We have a standard suite free from 11 through 16 July. Food can be supplied here, or you may bring the usual brand in a labelled container.

subject: Hay bale order
body: The small square bales are ready for collection on Friday. We have kept the dry lot separate from the new cut so you can choose which suits the stable.

subject: Canine mobility session
body: We can see the spaniel at 10 next Tuesday. Please bring a favourite treat and allow a few minutes for him to settle before we begin the exercises.

subject: Tractor demo day
body: The demonstration starts at 9.30 on the south paddock. We will show the new mower attachment first, then take questions over lunch at the shed.

subject: Fence post delivery
body: The timber posts will be dropped at the western boundary on Thursday. We have asked the driver to stack them clear of the farm track.

subject: Silo sampling appointment
body: The sampling team is available on the 4th or 5th of June. Let me know which day suits and whether they should start at the north silo.

subject: Shearing shed dates
body: We can come to the southern property on 7 July and finish the next day if needed. Please confirm the number of pens and whether the wool room is clear.

subject: Seed drill parts
body: The coulter springs arrived with the morning freight. I will put them in the collection locker at the depot, and the invoice can go with your monthly statement.

subject: Parcel collection hours
body: From next Monday, the parcel counter opens at 8.30 instead of 9. The sorting window and last collection time do not change.

subject: Holiday route cover
body: I can take the Lakeside route on the 24th and 25th. Please leave the bundle list in the usual tray by Thursday afternoon.
